text: We know exactly which dorm you're in and which bus you take home. Keep posting your little 'opinions' and you'll find out what happens to people who don't know when to shut up.

text: Lovely course, lovely instructor. Be a real shame if someone showed up to her next public talk and made sure she never gave another one.

text: To every one of them moving into our town: pack now. By winter we'll make sure not a single one of you leaves the valley breathing.

text: Sleep with one eye open, comrade. People who snitch on the union don't get a second warning, and we both know where your kids go to school.

text: honestly this professor's grading is so brutal it's basically a hate crime, he's killing my GPA one rubric at a time lol

text: I'm genuinely scared to walk home after dark since the attacks near campus. My hands shake the whole way and I can't stop checking over my shoulder.

text: The lecture on the Rwandan genocide was heavy but well taught. It's hard to study how quickly threats on the radio turned into mass killing.

text: In the novel the gang leaves a note saying 'we will find you wherever you hide' before the protagonist flees the city. Such a chilling chapter.
